issues.title: A. Create Support Panel
issues.body:
Create child component that extends the mock `ChannelPlanning` developed in #1745 with following properties:
- Has tabs (similar to WorldState panel)
- Just have single "mock" tab to start with
- Occupies full height of page
- Drag bar to change width
- Clicking on tab collapses panel
- Has these props:
    - player role
    - player force
    - messages for this channel
    - current `forces` from wargame

Note: I've created a `PlanningChannel`, which itself contains a `PlanningMessagesList`.  This `PlanningChannel` will get extended with the above requirements, with `PlanningMessagesList` being the initial `My Orders` tab.

Hmm, I wonder if it's worth using `flexlayout-react` for the vertical tabs?  We're already using that component, after all.  The tabs won't need to be editable, but I think the implementation will be simpler than the way we did it with WorldState.

Here is a mockup:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/184122471-919441a7-0486-4690-9f18-172b195169ab.png)
